facts.text: I'm a bounty hunter, Django. Supper's on me tonight, don't mistake it for charity.
facts.why: Not found among Schultz's lines on the quote page. His real saloon line is 'Good morning, innkeeper! Two beers for two weary travelers.' This one is printed in quote marks.
facts.fix: Two beers for two weary travelers.

facts.text: Monsieur Candie's favourite. Don't speak French.
facts.why: Candie is obsessed with all things French and cannot speak it, but no source I opened has him drinking cognac.
facts.fix: Monsieur Candie loves all things French. He does not speak it.
